# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Placement Strategy

### 1.1 Architecture Constraints (from `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`)
The Nemotron-H model uses a **Hybrid Mamba-Attention-MoE** structure with three critical tensor categories for latency-sensitive placement:

| Tensor Category | Exact Tensor Names | Memory per Layer | Recurrence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | ~14.5 KB (weights only) | **Recurrent** (`is_recr(i) == true` when `n_head_kv == 0 && n_ff == 0`) |
| **Attention** | `attn_norm`, QKV weights (`create_tensor_qkv`), `wo`, `wo_b` | ~40 KB (weights only) | Dense |
| **Shared-Expert MoE** | `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b`, `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~120 KB (weights only) | Dense (gating + routing) |
| **NextN/MTP Draft Heads** | `nextn.enorm`, `nextn.hnorm`, `nextn.eh_proj`, `nextn.shared_head_norm`, `attn_post_norm`, `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | ~120 KB (weights only) | Draft-only |

### 1.2 Memory Budget Calculation (12GB GPU = 12,288 MB)
Assuming a **31B model** (52 layers, typical Nemotron-H config):

| Component | Calculation | GPU Memory |
|---|---|---|
| **Model Weights (FP16)** | 52 layers × ~512 MB/layer ≈ 26.6 GB | **Overflows GPU** |
